annotations.title: Gross salary needed for a target Dutch net salary

description: Reverse salary calculation for salary negotiations in the Netherlands (2026): the gross annual and monthly salary needed to take home a given net amount, with or without holiday allowance and the 30% ruling.

holiday_allowance_on_top.description: The salary gets 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

target_net_monthly.description: Net pay wanted per month in euros (yearly net / 12, so including holiday allowance when that is on)

thirty_percent_ruling.description: Will have the 30% ruling. Default false.
